task: Break the Telugu audio into chunks no longer than 20 seconds, cutting at natural pauses, and give me the list of clip paths. I'll review the audio by hand, so skip any transcript.

task: The Hindi monologue is too long for a single upload. Split it into chunks under 28 seconds at silence boundaries and tell me how many files were produced; I don't need any text out of it.

task: The three-and-a-half-minute Hindi monologue needs to become one continuous Hindi transcript. Please don't hand me a folder of short clips — I want the full text in a single result.
rationale: transcribe_audio inspects duration and, above 30 seconds, slices at silence boundaries with max_chunk_sec=28 and joins the per-chunk transcripts into one string. A separate chunk_audio call would create exactly the clip files the user rejects.

task: Scan only the first two pages of the IndicNLP paper and return the text, rendering any tables as HTML. Leave the remaining pages unprocessed.
